verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox supports detached command execution, persistent/resumable sandboxes, and configurable timeouts that can be extended, which enable background-running workloads, but it is fundamentally an on-demand execution environment invoked via SDK/CLI rather than a scheduler or trigger system for autonomous automations (no cron/webhook/event-trigger orchestration layer is documented). missing for 10: built-in scheduling/triggering mechanism (cron, webhooks, event-based triggers) to autonomously kick off sandbox runs without external orchestration, and independent evidence of long-running unattended automations in production.
